description: This Java class implements a business step for recalculating interest on loans within the Fineract platform's COB (Close of Business) process. It checks loan status and conditions before performing interest recalculation.

classes.name: LoanInterestRecalculationCOBBusinessStep
classes.description: Implements a COB business step to handle interest recalculation for loans, with logic to determine when recalculation should occur.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Performs interest recalculation on a loan if certain conditions are met, managing thread context and logging.

methods.name: hasOverdueInstallment
methods.description: Checks if the loan has any overdue installments that are not obligations met.

methods.name: getEnumStyledName
methods.description: Returns the enum style name for this business step.

methods.name: getHumanReadableName
methods.description: Returns a human-readable name for this business step.
